unknown_terms.context: Vessel name as written mixes Cyrillic homoglyphs (U+0410 'A', U+0435 'e') with Latin letters, rendering visually as 'MV ARES MARINER'. Normalized to Latin 'MV ARES MARINER'; flagged because mixed-script identifiers can cause downstream mismatch and require broker confirmation of the exact vessel.
Load port contains an embedded zero-width space (U+200B) inside 'Isken​derun'; normalized to 'Iskenderun, Turkey' with the invisible character stripped.
A right-to-left override control character (U+202E) appears in the REMARK line; stripped during normalization so it does not corrupt or reverse adjacent field values.
